cues.en: I would have been out here a little bit sooner, but they gave me the wrong dressing room and I couldn't find any place to put my stuff. And I don't know how you are, but I need a place to put my stuff. So that's what I've been doing back there. Just trying to find a place for my stuff. You know how important that is. That's the whole meaning of life, isn't it? Trying to find a place for your stuff. That's all your house is. Your house is just a place for your stuff. If you didn't have so much goddamn stuff, you wouldn't need a house. You could just walk around all the time.
cues.zh: 我本来能早点出来的，但他们给我指错了更衣室，搞得我连放东西的地方都找不到。我不知道你们怎么样，反正我是得有个地方放我的东西。所以我刚才在后台就忙着这事儿。就是想找个地方放东西。你们懂这有多重要。这就是人生的全部意义，不是吗？找个地方放你的东西。你的房子不就是干这个的嘛。房子就是个放你东西的地方。要不是你有那么一大堆该死的东西，你根本不需要房子。你大可成天在外面晃悠。

cues.en: That's all your house is, it's a pile of stuff with a cover on it. You see that when you take off on an airplane and you look down and you see everybody's got a little pile of stuff. Everybody's got their own pile of stuff. And when you leave your stuff, you gotta lock it up. Wouldn't want somebody to come by and take some of your stuff. They always take the good stuff. They don't bother with that crap you're saving. Ain't nobody interested in your fourth grade arithmetic papers. They're looking for the good stuff.
cues.zh: 你的房子仅此而已，就是一堆盖了个盖子的东西。你坐飞机起飞时往下一看就明白了，每个人都有一小堆东西。每个人都有自己的一堆东西。当你离开你的东西时，你得把它锁好。免得有人顺手牵羊拿走你的东西。他们偷的还总是好东西。没人稀罕你攒下的那些破烂。谁会对你四年级的算术试卷感兴趣啊。他们盯上的都是好东西。

cues.en: That's all your house is it's a place to keep your stuff while you go out and get more stuff Now sometimes sometimes you've got to move you got to get a bigger house. Why too much stuff? You've got to move all your stuff and maybe put some of your stuff in storage Imagine that there's a whole industry based on keeping an eye on your stuff Enough about your stuff. Let's talk about other people's stuff
cues.zh: 你的房子归根结底就是个放东西的地方，好让你能腾出手去搞更多的东西。有时候，你不得不搬家，换个更大的房子。为什么？东西太多了！你得把所有东西搬走，可能还得把一部分存到仓库里。想想看，居然有一个完整的产业专门替你看着你的东西。关于你自己的东西就聊到这儿吧。咱们来聊聊别人的东西。

cues.en: Did you ever notice when you go to somebody else's house, you never quite feel a hundred percent at home? You know why? No room for your stuff. Somebody else's stuff is all over the place. And what awful stuff it is. Where did they get this stuff? And if you have to stay overnight at someone's house, you know, unexpectedly and they give you a little room to sleep in that they don't use that often, someone died in it 11 years ago and they haven't moved any of his stuff.
cues.zh: 你有没有发现，去别人家做客时，你永远无法百分之百感到自在？知道为什么吗？因为没地方放你的东西。到处都摆满了别人的东西。而且都是些什么烂玩意儿啊。他们到底从哪儿弄来这些破烂的？如果你不得不在别人家过夜，比如临时借宿，他们给你安排了一间平时不太用的小卧室，11年前有人死在里面，而且他们连一件遗物都没挪动过。

cues.en: Or wherever they give you to sleep, usually right near the bed there's a dresser and there's never any room on the dresser for your stuff. Someone else's shit is on the dresser. Have you noticed that their stuff is shit and your shit is stuff? Now, sometimes you go on vacation, you gotta bring some of your stuff with you. You can't bring all your stuff, just the stuff you really like. The stuff that fits you well that month.
cues.zh: 或者不管他们安排你睡哪儿，床边通常都会有个梳妆台，但台面上从来没有空位放你的东西。上面全堆着别人的破烂。你注意到了没？他们的东西是破烂，而你的破烂才是宝贝东西！有时候你去度假，得随身带上一些东西。你带不走所有的东西，只能挑你真正喜欢的。那些那个月你穿起来最合身的东西。

cues.en: Let's say you're gonna go to Honolulu. You're gonna go all the way to Honolulu. You gotta take two big bags of stuff. Plus your carry-on stuff, plus the stuff in your pockets. You get all the way to Honolulu and you get in your hotel room and you start to put away your stuff. That's the first thing you do in a hotel room is put away your stuff. I'll put some stuff in here, put some stuff down there. Here's another place for some stuff here. I'll put some stuff over there. You put your stuff over there. I'm putting my stuff over here. Here's another place for some stuff. Hey, we got more places than we've got stuff. We're gonna have to buy more stuff.
cues.zh: 比方说你要去檀香山。大老远飞去檀香山。你得带上两大箱东西。外加随身行李里的东西，还有兜里的东西。等你一路折腾到了檀香山，进了酒店房间，第一件事就是开始收纳你的东西。你在酒店房间里做的第一件事绝对是收拾东西。“我把一些东西放这儿，一些东西放那儿。这儿还能放点东西。我把那部分放那边去。你的东西放那边，我的东西放这边。嘿，这儿还有个地方能放东西。天呐，这里空位比咱们的东西还多。咱们得去再买点东西了。”

cues.en: and you put all your stuff away and you know that you're thousands of miles from home and you don't quite feel at ease but you know that you must be okay because you do have some of your stuff with you and you relax in Honolulu on that basis that's when your friend from Maui calls and says hey why don't you come over to Maui for the weekend spend a couple of nights over here oh shit no now what stuff do you bring
cues.zh: 你把所有东西都收好，也知道自己离家几千英里，心里不太踏实；但你知道自己必须没事，因为你确实带了一些自己的东西，于是你就凭着这一点在 Honolulu 放松下来。就在这时，Maui 的朋友打电话说：嘿，周末来 Maui 玩吧，在这边住两晚。妈的，不行，这下你该带什么行李？

cues.en: Right, you've got to bring an even smaller version of your stuff. Just enough stuff for a weekend on Maui. And you get over, and you're really spread out now. You've got shit all over the world! You've got stuff at home, stuff in storage, stuff in Honolulu, stuff in Maui, stuff in your pocket. Supply lines are getting longer and harder to maintain. But you get over to your friend's house in Maui, and they give you a little place to sleep, and there's a little window ledge or some kind of a small shelf, and there's not much room on it, but it's okay, because you don't have much stuff now.
cues.zh: 对，你得带一个更小版本的东西，只够在 Maui 过个周末。你到了那边，现在你的东西真的铺开了。你的破玩意儿遍布全世界！家里有，仓库里有，Honolulu 有，Maui 有，口袋里有。补给线越来越长，越来越难维持。但你到了 Maui 朋友家，他们给你一小块睡觉的地方，有个小窗台或者某种小架子，上面没多少空间；不过没关系，因为你现在也没多少东西。

cues.en: and you put what stuff you do have up there, you put your imported French toenail clippers, your own readers with a 45-day guarantee, your cinnamon-flavored dental floss, and your Afrin 12-hour decongestant nasal spray. And you know you're a long way from home, you know that you must be okay because you do have your Afrin 12-hour decongestant nasal spray. And you relax in Maui on that basis.
cues.zh: 你把现有的东西放上去：进口的法国指甲钳、你自己那副带 45 天保证的老花镜、肉桂味牙线，还有你的 Afrin 12 小时减充血鼻喷剂。你知道自己离家很远，也知道自己必须没事，因为你确实有那瓶 Afrin 12 小时减充血鼻喷剂。于是你就凭着这一点在 Maui 放松下来。

cues.en: That's when your friend says hey, I think tonight we'll go over the other side of the island stay at my friend's house overnight Now you just bring the things you know, you're gonna need money keys comb wallet lighter hanky pen cigarettes contraceptives Vaseline whips chains whistles dildos in a book
cues.zh: 就在这时，你朋友说：嘿，我想今晚我们去岛的另一边，在我朋友家过夜。现在你只带那些你知道会用到的东西：钱、钥匙、梳子、钱包、打火机、手帕、笔、香烟、避孕用品、Vaseline、鞭子、链子、哨子、假阳具，还有一本书。
